chapter: Technique and life on the road (repeated passages)
title: Pop Monroe's needle whiskey and jamming with Lester Young in 1932
summary: He met Lester before Basie while jamming at Pop Monroe's in Kansas City during his time with Thamon Hayes; Lester sounded much the same then.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Did you first meet Lester with Basie or had you met him before?

No I met him before. We used to jam. Going jamming and up in Kansas City, we used to go to a place called Pop Monroe -- Pops Monroe. And he used to sell needle whiskey. They called it needle whiskey. It was corn but it was cured by a needle. And he had a pen up at his house and we used to go there and play all night long. Several guys. I just can't remember all the guys that used to go. So we'd just go up there and take out little -- I think you could get
Did Lester sound different to you then?
Well, Lester... No, he had the same kind of thing going, you know. There was him, Ben Webster... We all used to go up to Pop Monroe's, you know. Yes... I think that dinner is nearly about ready.
